[1] List Criteria: The best shampoos for clarifying hair. The best clarifying shampoo helps to clean hair thoroughly, removing all the built-up gunk that can accumulate on strands. Clarifying shampoos aren't usually for everyday use, but once in a while, detoxifying hair is necessary.

[2] The best shampoos for clarifying can help to remove all that nastiness, so your hair gets a fresh start. Clarifying shampoo can instantly transform drab, lifeless-looking hair into a shiny, bouncy mane.
URL: http://www.ranker.com/list/best-clarifying-shampoo/makeup-tips

[3] Best Answer: If it's permanent then you can't completely remove the dye from your hair, but you can fade the color, but some kind of color from the dye will still be in your hair. You'll have to cut it out if you want the color completely gone.

[5] What to Expect. Clarifying shampoos effectively remove temporary hair color. They help fade semi-permanent, demi-permanent, and permanent hair color as well. Even though these products are not intended to remove permanent hair color, you can expect anywhere from a slight variation in color to a couple levels of lift.
URL: http://www.yourbeautyadvisor.com/2012/03/hair-color-too-dark-here-are-your-options/

[6] To get rid of build-up from your conditioner, treatments and styling products. Even if you love your regular hair products, it's helpful to occasionally work in a clarifying shampoo to remove any build-up—especially of silicone-based conditioners and if you use any hairstyling products (even dry shampoo).
URL: http://beautyeditor.ca/2014/03/13/clarifying-shampoo

51603.question: What is the best beretta for home defense?
plausible_answers: Beretta 92FS
Beretta 1301 Tactical
A compact Beretta (PX4 Storm Compact or APX Compact)
51603.sources:
[1] I'll weigh in since I own variations of both of your choices. The Beretta 92fs is a good gun for a first home defense gun, so long as you're only considering a pistol and not a 12 gauge shotgun (which I would also recommend).The Beretta can take high capacity magazines, is quite accurate, and is a very reliable pistol.
URL: https://answers.yahoo.com/question/index?qid=20111221101204AAETWpU

[2] 1. CZ-75 SP-01: This is one of the best 9mm Handgun for Self-Defense I have ever seen, the plus point of this handgun is that it is a NATO certified gun and it's used by Czech police.
URL: http://geekstopten.com/10-best-9mm-handguns-self-defense/

[3] A rundown of the six best shotguns for home defense, including releases by Mossberg, Wilson Combat, Beretta and more.
URL: http://www.personaldefenseworld.com/2014/07/top-6-shotguns-home-security/

[4] Collapse. The 1301 is designed to give demanding tactical shotgun shooters the most desirable features right out of the box. With its compact size, ghost-ring sights, oversized controls and lightning-quick operation, it is possibly today's best shotgun for law enforcement, home defense and even 3-gun competition.
URL: http://www.beretta.com/en-us/1301-tactical/

[5] The SIG Sauer Tac Ops 1911 with Threaded Barrel is of the best handguns for home defense. Comparable: Para Ordnance 1911's, Kimber 1911's, Customs, the list goes on and on…. Pros: All steel build, makes the .45 ACP manageable for just about anyone.
URL: http://guncarrier.com/the-6-best-handguns-for-home-defense/

[6] The Beretta 92 is a great pistol for beginners due to the weight and ease of acquiring a sight picture. The magazine capacity of 15-rounds makes it a suitable choice for home defense or as a duty pistol for law-enforcement.The weight has some drawbacks as does the size for concealed carry.
URL: http://besthandgun.com/beretta-m92/

[7] 1301 Tactical: Ultimate Reliability for Home-Defense, Law-Enforcement. The 1301 is Beretta's new gas operated semi-automatic shotgun designed for law-enforcement and home-defense. Engineered to be ultra-reliable and easy to use, it has all the features that a modern tactical shotgun should offer—and more.
URL: http://www.beretta.com/en-us/1301-tactical/

[8] The Glock 19 is of the best handguns for home defense. Comparable: Steyr Pistols, All Glocks, Kahr Arms various models. Pros: Easy to use, take apart, put together, clean, and upgrade for any home defense need. Cons: No manual safeties come standard with a Glock.
URL: http://guncarrier.com/the-6-best-handguns-for-home-defense/

[9] And when used with the extended mag (I would recommend this for home defense use) it is an easy gun to control. The Smith & Wesson M&P Shield is of the best handguns for self defense. Comparable: Springfield XD subcompact, Glock subcompact.
URL: http://guncarrier.com/the-6-best-handguns-for-home-defense/

[10] Baby eagle is available in many calibers like 9mm, .45 ACP, .40 S&W, etc and in both Polymer and Steel frame with several Barrel lengths. The one I like is this, Full sized Baby Eagle 2 9mm with steel frame which is surely a Great deal, pretty much accurate. An Ideal 9mm handgun for Self-defense scenarios.
URL: http://geekstopten.com/10-best-9mm-handguns-self-defense/

51691.question: What is the best diet for reducing PMS symptoms?
plausible_answers: Mediterranean-style diet
Dairy-free / Cycle Diet
Anti-inflammatory elimination diet
51691.sources:
[1] 1. Vitamin B. Vitamin B is your ally when it comes to blasting the uncomfortable symptoms of PMS—such as mood swings, bloating, fatigue, and bad food cravings. So add a multivitamin or B12 complex to your regular diet or start eating more sweet potatoes, eggs, and chicken breast.
URL: http://www.activebeat.co/your-health/women/10-foods-that-soothe-pms-symptoms/

[2] You will learn why dairy, even organic dairy, may not be the best foods for women who suffer from PMS, PMDD or irregular cycles. You will also learn why conventionally raised animal protein, typical in a U.S. diet and very low-carb diets are problematic for women who present with PMS/PMDD symptoms.
URL: http://www.cyclediet.com/

[3] RELATED: The 12 Best Power Foods for Women. 1. Turkey. The tryptophan in this protein-rich poultry helps regulate levels of serotonin, a hormone that influences mood. Turkey also contains vitamin B6, which assists in the production of dopamine.
URL: http://www.shape.com/lifestyle/mind-and-body/eat-beat-pms

[4] Improve your diet. A salt-heavy diet can cause bloating, caffeine can aggravate irritability or anxiety, alcohol may worsen depression, and too much sugar can destabilize your blood sugar and mood. Try to eat more fruits, vegetables, and whole grains the week before your period.
URL: http://www.health.com/health/gallery/0,,20461504,00.html

[5] 3. Flaxseed. To reduce the severity of cramps, add a tablespoon or two of flax to your morning oatmeal or a smoothie. It's high in omega-3 fatty acids, which reduce inflammation and inhibit the production of prostaglandins, chemicals that can intensify muscle contractions.
URL: http://www.shape.com/lifestyle/mind-and-body/eat-beat-pms

[6] Foods that Decrease Your PMS Symptoms. PMS is never fun. Between the bloating, the cramping, the cravings and the mood swings, it's not exactly the best week of the month for any girl.
URL: http://www.shape.com/lifestyle/mind-and-body/foods-decrease-your-pms-symptoms

[7] PMS Symptoms & Causes. PMS symptoms usually start 7 to 10 days before menstrual flow begins and end shortly thereafter. PMDD (premenstrual dysphoric disorder) is the term used to describe severe PMS symptoms.
URL: https://draxe.com/pms-symptoms/

[8] Foods that are Good for Fighting PMS. 1. Fat is your friend. A recent study in the journal Reproductive Health found that women given a pill containing a mix of essential fatty acids significantly reduced their PMS symptoms.
URL: http://www.shape.com/lifestyle/mind-and-body/foods-decrease-your-pms-symptoms

[9] Welcome to The Cycle Diet. You've come to the right place if you suffer from cyclical symptoms of Premenstrual Syndrome (PMS), Premenstrual Dysphoric Disorder (PMDD) or a possible hormone imbalance. The Cycle Diet is nutrition therapy for any woman looking to improve her well-being while living with the natural fluctuations of the female hormones.
URL: http://www.cyclediet.com/

[10] Many medical experts point to fluctuating hormone levels as the culprit for uncomfortable PMS symptoms. But many would add that diet can play a huge role when it comes to the severity of PMS symptoms.
URL: http://www.activebeat.co/your-health/women/10-foods-that-soothe-pms-symptoms/

raw_answers: Dairy-free / Cycle Diet
Anti-inflammatory elimination diet
Mediterranean-style diet

Supplement-supported regimen
51693.sources:

URL: https://www.wikihow.com/Boost-Thyroid-Function

[2] If you feel your malaise is from a poorly functioning thyroid, some medical practitioners suggest trying a few easy remedies to see if you get positive results. [5] 8 Foods that Impact Thyroid Health. Your thyroid is a small, butterfly-shaped gland located in your neck. This gland is responsible for several essential bodily functions, including regulating metabolism, mood, energy, heart rate, blood pressure, and body temperature.

URL: http://www.activebeat.co/diet-nutrition/8-foods-that-impact-thyroid-health/

Antioxidants such as vitamins C and E, selenium and zinc, omega-3, and vitamin D3 should be supplemented with your choice of iodine as well.
URL: https://www.naturalnews.com/037147_thyroid_function_boosting_remedies.html

[10] Incorporate foods that support your thyroid. Certain foods can help your thyroid work better. For any thyroid disease, make sure you include the foods that support your thyroid gland. These foods include: Berries, such as blueberries, strawberries, raspberries, gooseberries, blackberries, elderberries, salmon berries, and blackberries.

51705.question: Which dog breed helps most with anxiety and depression?

A small companion breed (Cavalier King Charles Spaniel, Bichon Frise, Cockapoo)
A trained psychiatric service dog (Standard Poodle / German Shepherd)
51705.sources:
[1] Dogs can help symptoms of depression because they are pack animals and instinctively form close bonds with other members of their pack or family. By their very nature, they will help provide emotional support to other members of their pack by being loyal and affectionate companions.
URL: http://www.dogsfordepression.org.uk/how-dogs-help-us.html

[2] Dogs can help symptoms of depression because they are pack animals and instinctively form close bonds with other members of their pack or family.
URL: http://www.dogsfordepression.org.uk/how-dogs-help-us.html

URL: http://goodrelaxation.com/2013/02/what-are-best-dog-breeds-for-anxiety/

[4] Studies show that animals can reduce tension and improve mood. Along with treatment, pets can help some people with mild to moderate depression feel better.
URL: http://www.webmd.com/depression/features/pets-depression

URL: http://goodrelaxation.com/2013/02/what-are-best-dog-breeds-for-anxiety/

[6] Studies show that animals can reduce tension and improve mood. Along with treatment, pets can help some people with mild to moderate depression feel better. If you're depressed, here's a rundown of how pets could help. 1  Uncomplicated love.
URL: http://www.webmd.com/depression/features/pets-depression

[7] dog breeds for anxiety dog breeds for depression dog breeds that help with anxiety dog breeds that help with depression dog breeds to help you fight anxiety.
URL: http://www.everythingmixed.com/best-dog-breeds-help-anxiety/

[8] A four-legged companion in your life can bring a bounty of rewards. Not only do pets offer love and affection, but they can help keep your immune system strong, reduce depression, even lower blood pressure.
URL: http://pets.webmd.com/dogs/ss/slideshow-best-dog-breed-for-your-health

[9] 1 If you have a dog, that dog needs to be walked, Cook says. 2  A little extra physical activity is good for your physical and mental health. 3  Routine. 4  Having a daily schedule helps people with depression. 5  An animal's natural routine -- waking you in the morning, demanding food or walks -- can help you stay on track.
URL: http://www.webmd.com/depression/features/pets-depression

[10] 1 Dogs get you out of the house-fresh air, physical exercise and a change of scene are proven to help boost people's mood and ease depression symptoms. 2  Caring for a dog helps form a daily routine and structure that can help keep you going, one foot after the other.
URL: http://www.dogsfordepression.org.uk/how-dogs-help-us.html

51709.question: Which medication best relieves a common cold?
plausible_answers: An NSAID (ibuprofen / Advil or naproxen / Aleve)
A multi-symptom OTC like NyQuil or Tylenol Cold Multi Symptom Nighttime
51709.sources:
[1] Common cold medications. When you have a cold, it can be hard to sort through the dizzying array of over-the-counter cold medications. But many cold medications contain just a few types of drugs. The key is to check the list of ingredients and match the right drug to your symptoms.
URL: http://www.health.com/health/gallery/0,,20456799,00.html

[2] You're coughing, you've got a stuffy nose, a sore throat — the full monty. But which products are worth the money and which should you skip? Consumer Reports chose the best over-the-counter drugs based on effectiveness and safety. Use its picks below to treat a run-of-the-mill cold.
URL: https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/health-science/for-cold-symptoms-here-are-the-best-over-the-counter-drugs/2014/01/06/3c55e578-40a9-11e3-a624-41d661b0bb78_story.html

[3] NyQuil is a very popular cold and flu medication. Because of recent changes in the law regarding the sale of decongestants, NyQuil no longer contains one. It still has medications to relieve pain/fever, sneezing/itching(antihistamine), and cough(suppressant).
URL: https://www.verywell.com/multi-symptom-cold-and-flu-medications-770677

[4] However, if you take medication on a regular basis, you should check with your doctor or pharmacist before taking any medication, especially those that treat multiple symptoms. You may be better off treating just one symptom at a time.
URL: https://www.verywell.com/multi-symptom-cold-and-flu-medications-770677

[5] The downside of using older antihistamines such as Chlor-Trimeton are side effects that include drowsiness, dry eyes and dry mouth, and urinary retention. Newer antihistamines, such as Claritin (generic: loratadine) and Zyrtec (generic: cetirizine), work better for allergies but not as well for colds.
URL: https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/health-science/for-cold-symptoms-here-are-the-best-over-the-counter-drugs/2014/01/06/3c55e578-40a9-11e3-a624-41d661b0bb78_story.html

[6] Fits of coughing and hacking can be upsetting, but OTC remedies that contain dextromethorphan won't do much to stop them. You're better off sucking on a lozenge, such as Luden's throat drops. They contain pectin and honey, which coat your raw throat and soothe the tickle that often triggers a coughing fit.
URL: https://www.washingtonpost.com/national/health-science/for-cold-symptoms-here-are-the-best-over-the-counter-drugs/2014/01/06/3c55e578-40a9-11e3-a624-41d661b0bb78_story.html

[7] Common Cold - Drugs for its Treatment. List of drugs used to treat the medical condition called Common Cold.
URL: http://www.medindia.net/drugs/medical-condition/commoncold.htm

[8] Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) fight inflammation and reduce fevers, so they are a good choice if you have a sore throat, headache, muscle aches, or fever. They include ibuprofen (Advil), aspirin, naproxen and (Aleve), among others.
URL: http://www.health.com/health/gallery/0,,20456799,00.html

[9] If you have congestion, fever, itching or sneezing and a cough, Tylenol Cold Multi Symptom Nighttime may be right for you. 3 Aleve Cold and Sinus. Aleve Cold and Sinus is a cold and flu medication that treats nasal congestion and pain/fever for 12 hours.
URL: https://www.verywell.com/multi-symptom-cold-and-flu-medications-770677

[10] There are many different kinds, including diphenhydramine (Benadryl), brompheniramine (Dimetapp), and loratadine (Claritin). If you have a cold, the drugs' side effects may help you sleep, but they aren't the best choice for cold symptoms, Dr. Hueston says.
URL: http://www.health.com/health/gallery/0,,20456799,00.html

In Excel 2007 or later, click the Developer menu and click Macros. In the Macro Name list, click Enter_Values, click Run. This method works best if the data is arranged in a single column.

51730.question: Which type of exercise best protects aging joints?
plausible_answers: Low-impact aerobic exercise (walking, swimming, cycling)
Strength training with bands or light weights
Range-of-motion / flexibility work (yoga, tai chi, dancing)
51730.sources:
[1] Daily exercise, such as walking or swimming, helps keep joints moving, lessens pain, and makes muscles around the joints stronger. Three types of exercise are best if you have arthritis: 1  Range-of-motion exercises, like dancing, might relieve stiffness, keep you flexible, and help you keep moving your joints.2  Strengthening exercises, such as weight training, will keep or add to muscle strength. 3  Strong muscles support and protect your joints.
URL: https://www.nia.nih.gov/health/publication/arthritis-advice

[2] So, welcome to middle-age. As you age, muscle mass and bone density decrease and the cushioning in your joints wears down. When the cartilage in your joints deteriorates, this can cause arthritis—an inflammation of the joints that occurs as cartilage breaks down and bones rub together.
URL: http://www.ahchealthenews.com/2014/02/24/best-exercises-for-aging-joints/

[3] Getting active strengthens the muscles that support your joints. Aerobic exercise (cardio) helps your most important muscle: your heart. Because you'll be exercising several times a week, start thinking about what activities appeal to you, whether they're swimming, tennis, basketball, or something else you enjoy.
URL: http://www.webmd.com/arthritis/healthy-joints-14/slideshow-exercise-for-joints

[4] The following types of exercise are part of a well-rounded arthritis treatment plan. 1  Strengthening exercises. 2  These exercises strengthen muscles that support joints affected by arthritis. 3  They can be performed with weights or with exercise bands, inexpensive devices that add resistance.4  Aerobic activities.
URL: http://nihseniorhealth.gov/osteoarthritis/treatmentandresearch/01.html

[5] Exercises are good for healthy knees. There are several exercises that can help you keep your joints healthy and functioning well. Not all exercises are good for your joints; some are not good for your knees such as the high impact exercises. High impact exercises can worsen the situation of an already injured knee.
URL: https://www.consumerhealthdigest.com/joint-pain/joint-health-faqs/what-are-the-best-exercises-to-strengthen-aging-knees.html

[6] As you age, your muscles, bones, and joints go through a number of changes that will lead to decreased mobility and functionality without a proper exercise regimen.
URL: https://www.hss.edu/conditions_exercise-healthy-aging.asp

[7] Eat Fish to Reduce Inflammation. If you have joint pain from rheumatoid arthritis (RA), eat more fish. Fatty cold-water types like salmon and mackerel are good sources of omega-3 fatty acids.
URL: http://www.webmd.com/arthritis/ss/slideshow-keep-joints-healthy

[8] When weight training, for example, alternate between arm and leg exercises to avoid overworking one body part or joint within your exercise routine, says Christa Gurka, MSPT, a physical therapist and founder of Pilates in the Grove in Miami, FL.
URL: http://www.prevention.com/fitness/fitness-tips/workout-tips-joint-pain-aging-and-rheumatoid-arthritis

[9] 4. Find the best cardio for you. To determine the best cardio program for your joints, Kruse recommends testing various progressions of impact to find your tolerance level. Start with the least impactful movement and slowly increase until you find your breaking point.
URL: http://www.prevention.com/fitness/fitness-tips/workout-tips-joint-pain-aging-and-rheumatoid-arthritis

[10] Exercise is crucial for people with arthritis. It increases strength and flexibility, reduces joint pain, and helps combat fatigue.
URL: http://www.mayoclinic.org/diseases-conditions/arthritis/in-depth/arthritis/art-20047971

[1] With so many inkjet printers available, your choices for a good greeting card printer are better than ever. But, for the serious amateur or pro photographer with print production in mind, the field of good printers narrows considerably.

[2] I have a basic Epson and it prints on cardstock. The ones that feed in the top are going to bend the paper less than bottom feeders. I have fed paper lunch bags into an old HP with a front feeder. You just have to have the printer at the right settings for paper type.

[3] I would love suggestions and feedback on printers that print on heavy cardstock for invitations specifically. I print on anything from #110 to #130. Paper types can vary from matte, metallic and linen. Printer needs to feed from the back so the cardstock doesn't bend or jam.

[4] Challenge inkjet printers with the task of printing on metallic paper and results are hit and miss, depending on the particular printer and the composition of the sheet's metallic finish. More printing limitations arise from wet ink sprayed onto the metallic paper surface.

[5] Hello, just looking for advice on the best Canon printer for printing on 7 x 10 cardstock. I want: 1  a toploading (or rear loading). 2  inkjet. 3  prints easily on cardstock. 4  able to set custom size paper size (7X10).

[6] Hello, just looking for advice on the best Canon printer for printing on 7 x 10 cardstock. I want: 1  a toploading (or rear loading). 2  inkjet. 3  prints easily on cardstock. 4  able to set custom size paper size (7X10). 5  not expensive!

[7] In order to create high-quality printed goods, you must start with a printer that specializes in printing on card stock. RedRiverCatalog.com states that there are particular characteristics found among inkjet printers that will cause them to produce quality greeting cards and other printed paper goods.

[8] Prior to printing on our paper, print on a test sheet of regular 8.5 x 11 paper to see which direction the text prints. Most printers print the information from top to bottom, which means the paper should be fed into top-feed printers upside down so the top of the card goes into the printer first.

[9] I print on anything from #110 to #130. Paper types can vary from matte, metallic and linen. Printer needs to feed from the back so the cardstock doesn't bend or jam. I am looking for a high quality end product of course, but I can't spend an arm and leg for it.

52215.question: best type of paint to paint over rust
plausible_answers: Brush-applied rust-inhibiting primer (zinc chromate or iron oxide) followed by a finish coat
Rustoleum (consumer brand) spray or brush-on
Direct-over-rust anti-rust enamel like Krylon Rust Protector or Rust Tough Enamel
52215.sources:
[1] Yes, you can spray paint over rust. Before you paint, take the time to prepare your surface properly. Spray paint surface preparation preparation is extremely important and is the best predictor of how long your new paint finish will last.emove loose rust with a wire brush, sandpaper or chemical rust remover. The goal is to make your surface as smooth as possible to ensure the new paint finish adheres well to the surface.

[2] Spray Paint Over Rust. After your surface is clean, dull, dry and primed appropriately, spray Krylon Rust Protector or Rust Tough Enamel on your well-prepared surface. Apply multiple thin coats to prevent runs and drips.Dries to the touch in 8 minutes and tack free in 15 minutes.emove loose rust with a wire brush, sandpaper or chemical rust remover. The goal is to make your surface as smooth as possible to ensure the new paint finish adheres well to the surface.

[3] 5. Place the steel on a drop cloth or cover the area around the steel with drop cloths, to avoid getting paint on it. 6. Brush a rust-inhibiting primer that includes zinc chromate or iron oxide onto the metal.Allow the primer to dry according to package directions. Repeat, if recommended. 1  Do not use a paint sprayer or spray paint cans for the rust inhibitor, because they will not reach into all the tiny pores on the steel's surface.2  You can also use an anti-rust enamel paint over 1 coat of regular primer.lace the steel on a drop cloth or cover the area around the steel with drop cloths, to avoid getting paint on it. 6. Brush a rust-inhibiting primer that includes zinc chromate or iron oxide onto the metal.

[4] Remove loose rust with a wire brush, sandpaper or chemical rust remover. The goal is to make your surface as smooth as possible to ensure the new paint finish adheres well to the surface.If your surface has any chipped or peeling paint, remove all loose paint. Lightly sand glossy surfaces to dull the finish.emove loose rust with a wire brush, sandpaper or chemical rust remover. The goal is to make your surface as smooth as possible to ensure the new paint finish adheres well to the surface.

[5] First make sure you can paint the object correctly. Some paints and rust-inhibitor paints want the steel to be rust-free. Other paints allow there to be some rust present. The instructions on the label almost always call for you to scrape off any flaking rust or metal scale.hen you do this, the finish paint can bond both chemically and mechanically to the primer. You get superior results when you can paint like this. I like to paint steel with a spray gun when I can. It takes some extra time to set up to prevent over-rust paint spray, but in the long run it can be a time saver.

[6] Loosen the rust with a wire brush. You can either do it by hand or use a wire wheel brush attachment inserted into a hand drill. 1  If you must prepare a large rusty steel surface, use a sand blaster to remove the rust. 2  A sandblaster uses compressed air and particles of sand to blow off the surface of the steel.lace the steel on a drop cloth or cover the area around the steel with drop cloths, to avoid getting paint on it. 6. Brush a rust-inhibiting primer that includes zinc chromate or iron oxide onto the metal.

[7] Although most types of paint will appear to cover rust upon application, the rust will eventually reappear unless it is properly sealed.Unfortunately, no paint will permanently cover rust unless a specific type of primer is applied first. Not all paints are compatible with this type of undercoating.lthough most types of paint will appear to cover rust upon application, the rust will eventually reappear unless it is properly sealed.

If you expose someone to this painting, they almost always feel the paint will not bond to the rust.hen you do this, the finish paint can bond both chemically and mechanically to the primer. You get superior results when you can paint like this. I like to paint steel with a spray gun when I can. It takes some extra time to set up to prevent over-rust paint spray, but in the long run it can be a time saver.

[9] You can also purchase a popular national brand rust paint called Rustoleum. I’ve used it for years with great success. This is a consumer brand paint that can be found in just about every hardware store and home center. It comes both in a rust spray as well as a brush-on paint.hen you do this, the finish paint can bond both chemically and mechanically to the primer. You get superior results when you can paint like this. I like to paint steel with a spray gun when I can. It takes some extra time to set up to prevent over-rust paint spray, but in the long run it can be a time saver.

52305.question: best way to get rid of ivy
plausible_answers: Manual pulling with hand tools (snipper, ladder, saw, shovel)
Natural spray: white vinegar OR salt + soap + water solution
Glyphosate (Roundup) or triclopyr (Brush-B-Gon) herbicide applied to leaves
52305.sources:
[1] Get rid of ivy before it takes over your home. Whether looking to eradicate poison ivy, English ivy or other ivy types, white vinegar is a safe, nontoxic method to rid your property of the plant, as vinegar's acid content makes it an ideal weed killer among its many other home uses. A salt and soap combination is another effective method of controlling ivy. 2  Combine three pounds of salt with 1/4 cup of liquid soap in one gallon of water, then pour the mixture into a spray bottle or garden sprayer. 3  Apply boiling water to plant roots daily to kill ivy.

[2] Rinse your skin. If you are outdoors when the poison ivy strikes, head for a stream or the beach for some water. Rinse the area that came in contact with cold water, being careful not to touch it too much with your hands or other parts of your body.ake an oatmeal bath. Oatmeal has long been used as a skin-soothing agent, and can be added to a bath to create a relaxing soak. Buy an oatmeal bath product or grind a cup of oatmeal in your blender and add it to a bath full of warm water. Soak in the mixture for 20 minutes to remove the itch of the rash.

[3] This article on glyphosate is a good starting point: U.S. researchers find Roundup chemical in water, air). Firstly, try pulling the plants. This may be the best way to be rid of poison ivy since it works fast and you can see immediate results.Interestingly, there are some people who are virtually immune to the allergic effects of poison ivy.n fact, if you see poison ivy in a part of your yard where no one will touch it, better to leave it for the wildlife that live there than try to remove it. Doing your part for the environment — no manual labor required. Related stories on MNN: 1  Poison ivy is getting tougher, stronger and angrier.

[4] 3. Spray ivy infestations thoroughly with white vinegar. 52328.question: best way to lose weight for a child
plausible_answers: Whole-family lifestyle change with the choosemyplate.gov plate method (half fruits/veggies, quarter lean protein, quarter whole grains) plus aerobic exercise
Pediatrician-led monitoring with attainable goals (1-4 lb/month), a food diary, and biweekly weight checks
A formal multi-disciplinary weight loss program for children whose home efforts fail
52328.sources:
[1] When you and your child's doctor have determined that your child needs to lose weight, a serious attempt to treat the problem should be undertaken. Here are some tips to get you started. 1  Set goals. 2  Just like with adult weight loss, the weight loss goals in children should be attainable, allowing for normal growth. The goals should initially be small, so that the child doesn't become discouraged or overwhelmed. 2  A five to 10 pound weight loss is a reasonable first goal -- about 1 to 4 pounds per month. 3  Food diary.

[2] 1 Set goals. 2  Just like with adult weight loss, the weight loss goals in children should be attainable, allowing for normal growth. 3  The goals should initially be small, so that the child doesn't become discouraged or overwhelmed. 4  A five to 10 pound weight loss is a reasonable first goal -- about 1 to 4 pounds per month. The goals should initially be small, so that the child doesn't become discouraged or overwhelmed. 2  A five to 10 pound weight loss is a reasonable first goal -- about 1 to 4 pounds per month. 3  Food diary.

[3] Losing weight as a kid can be difficult. Very few diets are created for children and diet programs for adults are often unhealthy for children since they are target more mature metabolisms.Still, there are many ways for young children to lose weight, and become healthier and happier.ery few diets are created for children and diet programs for adults are often unhealthy for children since they are target more mature metabolisms. Still, there are many ways for young children to lose weight, and become healthier and happier.

[4] Look for the following characteristics when choosing a weight loss program for your child. The program should: 1  Be staffed with a variety of health professionals:The best programs may include registered dietitians, exercise physiologists, pediatricians or family doctors, and psychiatrists or psychologists. The goals should initially be small, so that the child doesn't become discouraged or overwhelmed. 2  A five to 10 pound weight loss is a reasonable first goal -- about 1 to 4 pounds per month. 3  Food diary.

[5] If the answer is that your child does need to lose some weight my best advice is to work on incorporating more fruits and vegetables into their diet. Ensure 1/2 the plate is fruits and vegetables, 1/4 of the plate is lean protein and 1/4 of the plate is whole grains. child on a calorie restricted diet may not be the best option except in specific circumstances, and even then be sure to work closely with your pediatrician and a Registered Dietitian. In all cases, lifestyle changes to promote a healthier weight must include the entire family and not just your child.

[6] If your efforts at home are unsuccessful in helping your child reach a healthy weight and your doctor determines that your child's health is at risk unless he or she loses weight steadily, you may want to consider a formal weight loss program. The goals should initially be small, so that the child doesn't become discouraged or overwhelmed. 2  A five to 10 pound weight loss is a reasonable first goal -- about 1 to 4 pounds per month. 3  Food diary.

[7] The best diet for children trying to lose weight is a well-balanced, appropriately proportioned diet. A great resource for choosing a healthy diet is choosemyplate.gov, which details the proportions of food children should eat. There are great recipes and a lot of useful information. child on a calorie restricted diet may not be the best option except in specific circumstances, and even then be sure to work closely with your pediatrician and a Registered Dietitian. In all cases, lifestyle changes to promote a healthier weight must include the entire family and not just your child.

[9] Quick weight loss for a child is not a good idea. Keep the child's (and family's) diet very healthy: lots of vegetables, fruit, meat, dairy, breads, cereals and grains. 52348.question: best way to quit caffeine
plausible_answers: Gradual taper using progressive decaf mixing over 4-5 weeks
Cold turkey scheduled on a weekend / holiday with pain relievers on hand
Substitute with caffeine-free alternatives plus a quit-buddy / accountability partner
52348.sources:
[1] 1 The best way to avoid caffeine withdrawal entirely is not to get hooked on it in the first place! 2  If you want to drink coffee, tea, or soda, it is almost always possible to find a caffeine-free or decaffeinated version. 3  Avoid caffeine pills. 4  Caffeine pills contain more caffeine than most people think -- about 200 mg.

[2] Well, you can! Caffeine is a drug, and like any drug, in order to free yourself from addiction, you have to be committed to your plan of action, and be ready for the pain and of withdrawal. The key to quitting is the knowledge that things will get worse before they get better, but it will get better.

[3] 1 The third week, use 1/2 and 1/2. 2  The fourth week, use 1/4 regular and 3/4 decaf. 3  The fifth week, you're drinking decaf! 4  If you wish to reintroduce caffeine into your diet on a non-addicted basis limit yourself to one cup of tea or coffee every other day, preferably in the morning and no later than early afternoon.

[4] 1 The fifth week, you're drinking decaf! 2  If you wish to reintroduce caffeine into your diet on a non-addicted basis limit yourself to one cup of tea or coffee every other day, preferably in the morning and no later than early afternoon.

[5] Whichever the reason, quitting caffeine isn’t easy since most people develop a strong dependance on the daily dose; both physically and mentally. There are generally two ways to detox from caffeine and we describe each of those methods below.

[6] 1 Don't start drinking too much caffeine! 2  The best way to avoid caffeine withdrawal entirely is not to get hooked on it in the first place! 3  If you want to drink coffee, tea, or soda, it is almost always possible to find a caffeine-free or decaffeinated version.

[7] 1 The best way to avoid caffeine withdrawal entirely is not to get hooked on it in the first place! 2  If you want to drink coffee, tea, or soda, it is almost always possible to find a caffeine-free or decaffeinated version. 3  Avoid caffeine pills.

[8] Don't go at it alone. Find someone to quit with you. If you can't find that kind of support, promise to someone whom you love and respect that you will quit caffeine. Thus, consuming caffeine in any form will make you break your promise, and this will provide you with another incentive to stay on the wagon.

[9] And in every situation, you're going to need a substitute.. Quitting caffeine isn't easy, but if you feel your consumption has become a bad habit, the best way to break it is to create a new one to put in its place. Enter, our list of the best coffee alternatives to help you kick your caffeine dependency -- for good.

[10] If you choose the cold turkey method it’s important that you know what to expect and to prepare in advance for the debilitating withdrawal symptoms that can follow. 1  Plan ahead so that the first couple days of detox fall on a weekend or work holiday. 2  Have pain relievers on hand and avoid driving.

[1] The 2016 summative grade of C corresponds to a 74.4 out of 100, up slightly from 74.3 in 2015, when the nation also earned a C. To score the states, the research center employs a best-in-class approach. For each indicator in a given category, the top state receives 100 points. All other states are awarded points their performance relative to that state. Category scores are calculated as the average of scores across indicators.

[2] The 10 Worst States for Getting an Education. NEW YORK (TheStreet) -- Grade school education in the United States has some well documented problems. Of 21 industrialized countries, the U.S.'s 12th graders rank 19th in math, 16th in science and last in advanced physics.

[3] 10 Worst National Education Systems. The United Nations’ Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization’s (UNESCO) Educational Development Index (EDI) tends to attract most attention for the countries that perform at the very top.

[4] Angola (0.685 EDI) Tenth on the list with an Education Development Index of 0.685 is Angola. With the highest Adult Literacy Rate (ALR) on this list of 70.1%, Angola still clearly stands head and shoulders above its continental compatriots on this list.

[5] But many people on the world stage believe that education is the ‘key’ to the growth of the developing world and that it is an indispensible resource that cannot be ignored. Below is a list of ten countries with the worst education levels in the world.

[6] Overall, Wallethub's rankings were somewhat similar to a recent list from the Annie E. Casey Foundation, which found the best states for education were Massachusetts, New Jersey, Vermont, New Hampshire and Connecticut. However, the foundation found the worst states were West Virginia, Louisiana, Mississippi, New Mexico and Nevada.

[7] In all but two of the states with the worst school systems, however, school districts spent less than $10,000 per pupil. The best statewide school systems tended to spend far more. Vermont, for example, led the nation with a per pupil expenditure of $18,882.

[8] 2016 Education Rankings Put States, Nation to the Test. Quality Counts' indicators have evolved over the past 20 years, shining a bright light on the U.S. education system. The Quality Counts 2016 report, published as the Jan. 7 issue of Education Week and online, included errors in the school finance analysis.

[9] Oklahoma is ranked as the 9th worst state on this list, but its overall education grade of B+ indicates that its policy is on the right track, according to the ALEC. Here is a list of the 10 states ranked last in the report. 10. Nebraska.

441101.question: list of the best suv cars for teens
plausible_answers: New compact SUV (2015 Mazda CX-5, Subaru Forester, or Mitsubishi Outlander AWD)
New midsize SUV (2015 Toyota Highlander)
Used 2009-model-year SUV at ~$15,000
441101.sources:
[1] New SUVs that are safe for your family and teen driver include the midsize 2015 Toyota Highlander, as well as the compact 2015 Mazda CX-5, Mitsubishi Outlander (AWD only) and Subaru Forester. These SUVs are both IIHS Top Safety Pick+ recipients and have NHTSA's highest five-star overall rating.

[2] Safest Cars for Teens: SUVs. If a large, dull sedan isn't your teen's ideal first car, McCartt suggests shopping for an SUV. With ESC dramatically reducing rollover risk, the inherent advantages offered by SUVs' greater size, weight and height emerge more clearly, the IIHS says in its January 2015 status report.

[3] As icing on the proverbial cake, each of the models on the best cars for teen drivers list carries reasonably low car-insurance rates – or at least as far as teen drivers are concerned.

[4] We selected the 15 cars on this list the pillars of safety, reliability, and affordability. And despite what you might expect, not all the cars are compact and midsize sedans. A number of models, including large SUVs and a few sports cars, are suitable choices for first-time drivers.

[5] Toyota Celica. For many teens, owning a sports car is nothing more than a distant dream. But parents and teens can find the ultimate compromise in the Toyota Celica. Once they get over the shock of seeing a cassette player for the first time, teens will enjoy this car just as much as their parents did.

[6] Lifestyle 7/18/2014 @ 8:32PM 85,728 views. The Safest Used Cars For Teen Drivers. Teenagers are more likely than other drivers to have the least safe types of cars, often ending up behind the wheel of vehicles that are old, small and without good crash protection. Those are the findings of new research conducted by the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety, a nonprofit financed by the insurance industry.

[7] [Slideshow: Safest Cars for Teens] Teens that have their own vehicle drive their vehicle more and are more likely to be in a crash, just because of that, says Anne McCartt, senior vice president of research at the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety.

[8] To that end, the experts at CarInsurance.com recently compiled a list of 14 used cars that should be ideal for teen drivers; we’re featuring them in the accompanying slideshow with our own commentary. Each is from the 2009 model year and is valued at $15,000 or less according to Edmunds.com.

[9] Earlier this week the group released a list of recommended used vehicles to help parents buy safe cars within their budgets, ranging from less than $5,000 to nearly $20,000. “A teenager’s first car is more than just a financial decision,” Adrian Lund, the institute’s president, said in a statement.

[10] Note that pickups and sport-utility vehicles were deliberately left off the list of best cars for teen drivers for apparent safety concerns. “While some pickups and SUVs score well, they’re really not great choices for novice drivers,” says CarInsurance.com consumer analyst Penny Gusner.
